questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign showing laws you must follow. You cannot turn right at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach the crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go across.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that travel slowly on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic signals to tell drivers that turning left on green does not give you the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road will curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: When you approach a railroad crossing, watch and listen carefully. Slow down and get ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection so you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road under normal conditions. You may need to drive slower if weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that you may lose control of your vehicle. Slow down when you see wet pavement because your car will need more time to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you about school zones. Watch for children and obey the speed limit in school zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. It is illegal to make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road direction is changing or the road is getting narrower. You may see this sign on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that cars may be merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Stay alert for vehicles joining the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see this three-sided sign. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that construction or roadwork is ahead. Watch for temporary traffic control devices and be alert in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Move to the left lane ahead of time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that the road will turn sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road intersects ahead.
